# Satori neuron (browser app)

> The Satori neuron as a client-side web app. It fetches data from sources,
> predicts the next value with a simple model, signs each prediction with the
> neuron's identity key, and publishes it. Everything runs in the browser tab:
> the keys, the database (DuckDB-WASM on OPFS) and the engine. There is no
> server of our own. It is built to be driven by people and by AI agents alike.

Status: step 2 of the roadmap (two keys + Docker import/export). Predictions
are published locally for now; central, the engine, Nostr and Base come next.

## Concepts

- Identity key: the neuron's own key (Evrmore address, "E…"). Stored
  unencrypted in this browser (Docker's `wallet.yaml`) so the neuron runs and
  signs from page load with nobody present. It signs every prediction.
- Vault key: holds funds. Stored encrypted with the passphrase (Docker's
  `vault.yaml`). **Unlock** (enter the passphrase) decrypts it into memory;
  **Lock** wipes it. The neuron does not need the vault to run.
- Stream: a source URL (https, JSON) + a dotted path to a number
  (`data.amount`) + an interval in seconds (10 to 86400). Each interval the
  neuron stores an observation, fits a least-squares line over the last 20
  observations (in time), predicts the value one interval ahead, signs it and
  publishes it.
- Signed prediction: the message is the JSON
  `{"stream","ts","target_ts","value","model","address"}` (that key order, no
  spaces), signed as an Evrmore signed message (base64), verifiable against
  the identity address.

## Drive it from the page (window.satori)

Open the app, wait for it to load, then in the page's JS context:

- `await satori.status()` → `{ screen, identity, vault, unlocked, streams }`.
  `screen` is `setup` (no keys yet), `home` (running), `elsewhere` (another
  tab has it open; only one tab runs the neuron) or `fatal`.
- `await satori.setup({ passphrase, vaultWords?, identityWords? })` → status.
  Creates the neuron on a fresh browser (random keys unless 24 words are
  given). Passphrase: at least 4 characters, Latin-1 only (no emoji or €), as
  Docker's vault encryption needs. The vault starts locked. One setup runs at
  a time: a call while another (or the UI's) is running throws `Busy (setup)…`,
  and a call once set up throws `Already set up`.
- `await satori.addStream({ name, url, path, interval_s })`;
  `await satori.removeStream(name)` (deletes its data).
- `await satori.predictions(stream, limit = 20)` → newest first, with
  `message`, `signature`, `address`, `value`, `target_ts`.
- `satori.verify(message, signature, address)` → boolean.
- `await satori.unlock(passphrase)`; `satori.lock()`.
- While unlocked: `satori.backup('identity' | 'vault')` → `{ words, wif }`;
  `satori.file('wallet.yaml' | 'vault.yaml')` → the Docker file's text.
  Only these exact names; anything else throws.

Errors are thrown as `Error` with a readable message (for example
`Wrong passphrase`, `Unlock the vault first`).

## Drive it from the UI

- Setup: "Create a new neuron" (shows the vault's 24 words, asks for three of
  them, then a passphrase), "Restore from words" (vault words, optional
  identity words), or "Import Docker files" (`wallet.yaml`, `vault.yaml`, the
  vault password). `wallet.yaml` is the unencrypted file and `vault.yaml` the
  encrypted one; files in the wrong slots, or a vault.yaml that is not
  encrypted, are refused with a message saying so.
- Home: both addresses with Copy buttons; the vault card has a "Vault
  passphrase" field and Unlock, or a Lock button in the header while unlocked.
  One card per stream (latest value, prediction, signed message under
  "Signed prediction", Remove). "Add a stream" form. "Backup" (needs Unlock):
  Identity words, Vault words, Download wallet.yaml, Download vault.yaml.
- Form fields have labels; elements carrying data have `data-test`
  attributes: `identity`, `vault`, `vault-state`, `obs`, `pred`, `message`,
  `signature`, `wif`.

## Docker neuron interop

The keys are Satori Lite's (github.com/SatoriNetwork/satori-lite and
github.com/SatoriNetwork/satorilib): one
32-byte secp256k1 secret per key = the private key = the BIP39 entropy of its
24 words. `wallet.yaml` / `vault.yaml` are read and written in Docker's format
(vault fields: AES-256-CBC, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1 × 1,000,000 over the password's
Latin-1 bytes), so a neuron moves between Docker and the browser by moving the
two files.

## Code

Repository: https://github.com/lastmeta/Satori (this app is the repository
root; branch `main`). Plain JavaScript ES modules, no
build step beyond Vite, MIT licensed.

- `src/main.js`: app wiring and `window.satori`.
- `src/keys/`: identity and vault (`index.js`), derivations and Evrmore
  signing (`keys.js`), Docker files (`docker.js`).
- `src/db/`: DuckDB-WASM on OPFS, schema migrations, small async API.
- `src/engine/`: `predict(points, at)`, least-squares line.
- `src/neuron/`: the tick (fetch → store → predict → sign → publish), the
  scheduler, the one-tab lock.
- `src/ui/`: ArrowJS screens.
- `docs/design/`: what is built and why (`OVERVIEW.md`, `keys.md`);
  `docs/future/`: the researched roadmap.
- `scripts/`: parity-vector generator run against satorilib (Python).
- Tests: `npm test` (vitest), `npm run e2e` (Playwright, Chrome).

## Contribute

Pull requests are welcome at https://github.com/lastmeta/Satori. Keep changes
small, tested (vitest / Playwright) and in plain JS; follow the patterns of the
Docker neuron (Satori Lite) and satorilib; update `docs/design/` and this file
with what you change.
